base_prompt: a close-up shot from a low camera angle looking upward. A young woman with a white bobcut with side-swept bangs, bright red eyes, white mouse ears with pink inner ears, pale skin and a slim athletic build stands arched over a crystal ball, both hands hovering around its base. She wears a floor-length purple wizard robe with a gold-edged shoulder cape embroidered with cheese wedges and stars, and a tall brimless cone hat of purple cloth covered in a gold cheese-wedge and shooting-star pattern, her mouse ears free at the sides; her robe sleeves and the hat ripple in a magical gust. The crystal ball rests on a purple table cloth in the bottom left foreground and glows blue; inside the crystalline orb floats a shining golden cheese wedge. She stares into the orb completely in awe, mouth agape with a slight greedy grin, eyes opened wide, the cheese wedge reflected in her pupils. An ornate dark oak chair stands behind her. An immense gothic library surrounds them, flanked by towering bookshelves. A small spiral of bluish glowing magical dust whirls around her and the orb, and loose pages of notes and a white goosefeather swirl through the air. The room is dark and leans red, lit mainly by the blue tint of the orb, while she is mainly purple. Ominous, magical and mysterious mood.

styles.style_text_long: Acid Pulp Scratchwork: Aggressive pulp-comic rendering driven by heavy black inks, angular silhouettes and dense scratch-like hatching. Dirty ochre, deep crimson, black and sudden bursts of incandescent yellow-orange form a restricted high-impact palette. Contours vary from thick graphic blocks to nervous engraved marks, while coarse stippling, imperfect fills and distressed printed texture prevent the image from feeling digitally clean. Illumination is translated into hard graphic eruptions instead of smooth gradients, with sharp directional marks radiating through darker areas. The overall treatment combines vintage pulp printing, underground comic abrasion and modern high-contrast digital inking.

styles.style_text: Dissolving into Brushstrokes style: illustration, tightly rendered focal core, extremities unraveling into fast directional dry-brush strokes, ragged streaks and free-floating gestural marks, no hard boundary between finish and raw stroke, visible bristle drag, inspired by Rene Gruau, Agnes-Cecile, Jeremy Mann, dissolving, brushstrokes, painterly, unfinished.
styles.style_text_long: Dissolving into Brushstrokes style: illustration. The subject is tightly and smoothly rendered at its focal core, with confident contours, idealized proportions and a sweeping composition. Toward the extremities, the rendering progressively unravels. Forms loosen into broad, fast, directional dry-brush strokes that peel away from the body, fragment into ragged streaks and break off into free-floating gestural marks, so the subject seems to be materializing out of, or dissolving into, the act of painting itself. The transition from polished realism to raw stroke is the central event of the image, with no hard boundary between them. The texture is opaque and tactile, with visible bristle drag, broken edges and abrupt starts and stops of pressure, set against a satin-smooth finish in the resolved passages. Sense of motion caught mid-transformation and a spontaneous, unfinished energy. Influenced by: René Gruau, Agnes Cecile, Jeremy Mann, Haddon Sundblom.

styles.style_text_long: Divisionism: A radiant color-driven painting style built on thousands of individually visible strokes and color marks that weave together into luminous fields of shimmering visual energy. Featuring intense chromatic separation, sparkling color interactions, jewel-like tonal richness, intricate surface patterning, and extraordinary light diffusion created through dense networks of pure color touches. Emphasizing optical brilliance, atmospheric glow, chromatic complexity, and vibrant visual rhythm through meticulous color placement and layered color relationships. Creating artwork with a dazzling, prismatic, and endlessly luminous appearance where every surface vibrates with color, light, and intricate painterly detail. Influenced by: Georges Seurat, Paul Signac, Henri-Edmond Cross, Theo van Rysselberghe.

Contours are strong and sinuous, skies and terrain share the same decorative rhythm, and thick oil paint keeps a tactile, handmade surface.

styles.style_text: Gustave Moreau Jeweled Painting: painting, dense shimmering linework drawn over glowing paint, deeply saturated glazes, intricate fine detail, scratched highlight accents, luminous dark depths, dreamlike layered surface, inspired by Gustave Moreau, Odilon Redon, Jean Delville, symbolism, oil painting, intricate, dreamlike.
styles.style_text_long: Gustave Moreau Style: An opulent visionary illustration style built on immense decorative detail, radiant jewel-toned color, and extraordinary ornamental craftsmanship. Featuring shimmering precious-metal accents, luminous textures, and endlessly detailed surfaces that transform every element into a work of precious artistry. Emphasizing splendor, mysticism, visual richness, and dreamlike spectacle through luxurious patterning, glowing color harmonies, refined silhouettes, and astonishing detail concentration. Creating artwork with a sacred, mythological, and breathtakingly ornate appearance overflowing with beauty, symbolism, and decorative magnificence. Influenced by: Gustave Moreau, Gustav Klimt, Odilon Redon, Byzantine mosaics.

styles.style_text_long: Vilhelm Hammershøi Style: A hushed, contemplative painting style built on muted, restrained tonal harmony achieved through subtle, almost imperceptible value shifts rather than dramatic contrast, a quiet, still interiority carried through sparse, uncluttered composition, softly diffused ambient illumination that avoids any harsh directional drama, meticulous restraint in every mark favoring understated precision over expressive flourish, and a melancholic, meditative stillness that feels solitary, austere, and quietly profound. styles.style_text_long: Obsidian Gouache Slash: Raw expressionist gouache built from dense near-black masses and forceful strokes of chalky white, interrupted by restrained crimson and charcoal-grey accents.
